is_anopheles.evidence: This is an epidemiological survey of human populations measuring Plasmodium falciparum prevalence and anaemia in children on Bioko Island; no mosquitoes were collected or studied.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study only references the kdr mutation in the discussion (page 11-12) as historical context from earlier literature; no resistance markers are assayed or reported.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype or allele frequency data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: No field-collected mosquito populations were analysed.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary longitudinal study analysing 13 years (2004–2016) of annual malaria indicator surveys on Bioko Island.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are reported by 18 sentinel sites across Bioko Island (e.g. Baney, Rebola, Punta Europa, Sacriba; Figure 1 and Figure 4).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Annual surveys were conducted in August/September each year from 2004 to 2016.

assessment.summary: This paper presents 13 years of annual malaria indicator survey data (2004-2016) tracking Plasmodium falciparum parasite prevalence and anaemia among children across 18 sentinel sites on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea. No mosquito collections, bioassays, or resistance marker genotyping were performed.
exclusion_reasons: No Anopheles mosquitoes collected or analysed
Does not report target insecticide resistance markers
